messages.snippet: Sarah, After the site visit and a first look at the records, my early read: - The interlock on CR-TR
messages.subject: Lyra — first read on exposure
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

After the site visit and a first look at the records, my early read:

- The interlock on CR-TR-12 was defeated with a spare actuator key (the PLC log shows it bypassed from 09:48). Keys were not controlled.
- There WAS a documented safe system of work requiring lock-off, but clearing mis-rolls live was informally tolerated to keep throughput. That hurts us on enforcement of the system.
- 2023 PUWER assessment is out of date and doesn't address interlock defeat.

My instinct is Medium culpability, Harm category 2. They're a large org (turnover ~£62m) so the numbers are not small. I'll model it once we have counsel's steer.

Tom

--
Tom Gallagher
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
